title: Ninja Gaiden II (Ninja Gaiden II Recompiled)
description: Ninja Gaiden II (Xbox 360, 2008) statically recompiled into native Linux and Windows builds, drawn by its own Vulkan renderer. A steady 60 fps, up to 8x render scale, widescreen and ultrawide, keyboard and mouse, mods, Steam Deck ready. Bring your own copy of the game.
